label: Formulated and introduced Ockham's Razor (Principle of Parsimony)
description: William of Ockham formulated and introduced the concept of "Ockham's Razor (Principle of Parsimony)", which became a seminal contribution in epistemology philosophy.
dialecticalTension: Formulating an epistemic apparatus to resolve central problems in epistemology.
historicalContext: Introduced during the Medieval & Islamic Golden Age as part of William of Ockham's canonical writings.
